sulfurCube.title: Sulfur cube launch mechanics
sulfurCube.scope: Java Edition 26.2 · Bouncy archetype · one ordinary direct non-projectile knockback call · cube initially at rest
sulfurCube.assumptions.intro: This first milestone keeps the following assumptions fixed:
sulfurCube.assumptions.call: The attack makes one ordinary damage knockback call with effect factor E = 1.
sulfurCube.assumptions.cube: The adult Bouncy sulfur cube starts with its feet at (0, 0, 0) and uses its JE 26.2 dimensions and properties.
sulfurCube.assumptions.aim: The aim point constructs the attacker's look direction; it is not a sampled collision point.
sulfurCube.assumptions.trajectory: The trajectory is an illustrative free-flight continuation without collisions, bouncing, fluids, or later attacks.
sulfurCube.invalidInputs: Enter finite numbers, use a whole-number trajectory horizon from 0 to 200 ticks, and keep the aim point distinct from the eye position.
sulfurCube.controls.title: Inputs
sulfurCube.controls.presetHelp: M1–M9 reproduce the direct-melee launch-direction experiments.
sulfurCube.controls.damageArgumentHelp: The nonnegative damage value passed to this knockback call; this is not necessarily health lost.
sulfurCube.controls.attackerFeetHelp: World coordinates used for the cube-to-attacker elevation calculation and horizontal base direction.
sulfurCube.controls.attackerEyesHelp: World coordinates supplied independently from the feet position. The presets use the standing-player eye height of 1.62 blocks.
sulfurCube.controls.aimPointHelp: Defines look direction from the eye position. It does not represent where the attack collided with the cube.
sulfurCube.controls.trajectoryTicksHelp: A whole number from 0 to 200 ticks. This does not simulate collisions or bounces.
sulfurCube.readout.title: Calculated launch
sulfurCube.readout.provenanceBehavior: Knockback behavior is derived from locally decompiled Java Edition 26.2 code.
sulfurCube.readout.provenanceData: Bouncy properties and sulfur cube dimensions are derived from Java Edition 26.2 data and runtime initialization.
sulfurCube.readout.standardMath: This version uses standard TypeScript number and trigonometric operations; source-precision emulation is planned separately.
